project.name: Datas.ar
project.summary: Open-source app that reads your device and runs the best open AI it can carry. Built on the projects below — Datas is the glue.

sources.name: llama.cpp
sources.role: The engine that runs the AI models (llama-server, pooling over RPC, benchmarks).

sources.name: Hugging Face Hub
sources.role: Where the open models are downloaded from, with verified file sizes and checksums.

sources.name: Qwen (Qwen3, 3.5, 3.6, 3.8, Qwen3-Coder-Next)
sources.role: Open-weight models in the catalog.

sources.name: Gemma 4
sources.role: Open-weight models in the catalog (E2B, E4B, 12B, 26B-A4B, 31B).

sources.name: gpt-oss 20B / 120B
sources.role: Open-weight models in the catalog.

sources.name: Phi-4 mini
sources.role: Open-weight model in the catalog.

sources.name: SmolLM3
sources.role: Open-weight model in the catalog.

sources.name: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning
sources.role: Open-weight model in the catalog.

sources.name: MiMo V2.6 Distill
sources.role: Open-weight model in the catalog.

sources.name: Unsloth GGUF conversions
sources.role: Ready-to-run model files where no official conversion exists.

sources.name: psutil
sources.role: Reads memory, CPU, disk and battery.

sources.name: py-cpuinfo
sources.role: Reads the processor name and features.

sources.name: nvidia-ml-py
sources.role: Reads NVIDIA graphics memory.

sources.name: FastAPI + Starlette + uvicorn
sources.role: The local server behind the window.

sources.name: pywebview
sources.role: Shows the app in its own window instead of a browser.

sources.name: pydantic
sources.role: Checks the catalog file is well-formed.

sources.name: httpx
sources.role: Downloads and talks to AI services.

sources.name: python-zeroconf
sources.role: Finds your other devices on the home network.

sources.name: typer + rich
sources.role: The command-line version for advanced users.

sources.name: platformdirs
sources.role: Finds the right folders on each operating system.

sources.name: PyInstaller + Inno Setup
sources.role: Package the Windows installer.

sources.name: llmfit, canirunllm, llm-checker
sources.role: Earlier tools whose idea — match models to hardware with plain arithmetic — Datas follows.

sources.name: exo
sources.role: Showed home devices can share one big model; inspiration for pooling.

sources.name: PocketPal AI, Google AI Edge Gallery
sources.role: References for the Android app.
